audience: volunteer coordinators and nonprofits that run volunteer programs on Galaxy Digital

useCases.title: See which volunteer needs are still open
useCases.text: List the needs with title, agency, dates and the number of volunteers wanted. Filter by agency or status.

useCases.title: Review who signed up for a shift
useCases.text: Open a need and list its sign-ups with the volunteer, shift and status. Read the custom questions that volunteers answered.

useCases.title: Sum up the volunteer hours of a period
useCases.text: List the logged hours with user, need, date and approval status. Ask the assistant for totals per need.

useCases.title: Look up a volunteer and find who holds a qualification
useCases.text: Search the users by name or email and read the profile. List the users who hold a qualification or a benchmark to find the right volunteer.

useCases.title: List the managers of an agency
useCases.text: Open an agency and read its managers. Use the list to find the contact for a need.
